verdict.rationale: Gide's Intellectual Property practice page lists "know-how, and trade secrets" among the rights it covers, so trade secrets are within scope. However, its litigation claims cite only patent and trademark cases, and none of the specific trade-secret work in the story is described. Missing for 10: documented confidentiality-program or trade-secret protection work, employee-mobility or non-compete dispute work, trade-secret litigation matters or references, and independent corroboration such as rankings or case examples.
